disposition_reason: Validated CVAAS method applied to 32 Greek beehive samples; mercury was below the method LOD in every honey, pollen and propolis sample, recorded as non-detects.

study.design: Method development and survey of beehive matrices from 13 apiaries in rural, industrialized and mining-adjacent areas
study.origin: Northern and Western Greece: Kozani, Sindos, Chalkidiki, Arta
study.method: Cold vapor AAS after HNO3/H2O2 closed-vessel microwave digestion
study.lod_text: Method LOD: honey 0.05 μg/g, pollen 0.06 μg/g, propolis 0.3 μg/g, bees 0.8 μg/g dw
study.qa: Spike recoveries 64-129% (RSD 0.8-13%) in honey, propolis and bees; no CRM

findings.group: all samples, Kozani, Sindos, Chalkidiki and Arta apiaries
findings.notes: Hg below the method LOD in all honey samples.
